The position is described below. If you want to apply, click the Apply Now button at the top or bottom of this page. If you already have a profile with us, you can log in to check status. 
 
 Need Help? 
 
 If you have a disability and need assistance with the application, you can request a reasonable accommodation. Send an email to Accessibility (accommodation requests only; other inquiries won't receive a response). 
 
 Regular or Temporary: 
Regular 
 Language Fluency:  English (Required)
 
 Work Shift: 
1st shift (United States of America) 
 
 Please review the following job description: 
 
Designs, builds, automates, and optimizes enterprise DevOps platforms and cloud infrastructure to enable scalable, secure, and reliable software delivery. Leverages expertise in CI/CD pipeline engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud automation, and scripting to improve developer productivity, deployment quality, operational efficiency, and platform reliability. 
 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.
 Design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitLab to support application delivery across multiple environments.
 Automate software build, test, security scanning, deployment, and release processes to improve delivery speed, consistency, and reliability.
 Develop, maintain, and optimize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform for provisioning and managing AWS cloud infrastructure.
 Build and maintain reusable GitLab CI/CD templates, shared libraries, and DevOps standards to enable consistency across engineering teams.
 Develop automation solutions using Shell scripting, Python, and other tooling to streamline infrastructure management, operational tasks, and deployment activities.
 Manage and support AWS cloud services, ensuring availability, security, scalability, and cost optimization of cloud resources.
 Implement DevSecOps controls by integrating security scanning, vulnerability management, compliance checks, and policy enforcement into CI/CD pipelines.
 Monitor pipeline performance, deployment metrics, and infrastructure health; identify bottlenecks and implement continuous improvements.
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex build, deployment, infrastructure, and automation issues across development, testing, and production environments.
 Collaborate with software engineering, platform engineering, cybersecurity, cloud, and infrastructure teams to implement modern DevOps practices and improve software delivery capabilities.
 Support cloud migration, platform modernization, and automation initiatives while adhering to organizational governance, risk, and compliance requirements.
 Review infrastructure and pipeline architectures, provide technical guidance, and mentor junior engineers on DevOps best practices and cloud-native technologies.
 Lead infrastructure and deployment automation projects and contribute to enterprise DevOps strategy and operational excellence initiatives.
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications 
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
2. Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in infrastructure engineering.
3. Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies including cloud, network, database, storage, platform, computing, and middleware.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Master’s degree in a relevant technical discipline. Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cloud Computing, or a related technical discipline. Experience within the financial services, banking, or payments industry.
 Industry Certifications such as: 
 AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional
 AWS Solutions Architect Professional
 AWS SysOps Administrator
 Experience implementing and managing enterprise-scale GitLab CI/CD platforms and pipeline governance.
 Strong expertise in Terraform, Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, and Infrastructure as Code automation.
 Experience with AWS services including EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, IAM, Route53, Lambda, CloudWatch, VPC, Security Hub, and CloudTrail.
 Experience integrating DevSecOps tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk, Prisma Cloud, Aqua, Trivy, or similar security platforms.
 Experience with automated testing, release orchestration, deployment strategies, and environment management.
 Strong understanding of container platforms, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application architectures.
 Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, or CloudWatch.
 Proven experience leading DevOps transformation initiatives, CI/CD modernization efforts, and cloud platform engineering projects.
 Experience supporting highly regulated environments with strong focus on security, compliance, audit readiness, and operational risk management.
 
 
 
 General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible Employees of Truist Financial Corporation: All regular teammates (not temporary or contingent workers) working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for benefits, though eligibility for specific benefits may be determined by the division of Truist offering the position. Truist offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, accidental death and dismemberment, tax-preferred savings accounts, and a 401k plan to teammates. Teammates also receive no less than 10 days of vacation (prorated based on date of hire and by full-time or part-time status) during their first year of employment, along with 10 sick days (also prorated), and paid holidays. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site . Depending on the position and division, this job may also be eligible for Truist’s defined benefit pension plan, restricted stock units, and/or a deferred compensation plan. As you advance through the hiring process, you will also learn more about the specific benefits available for any non-temporary position for which you apply, based on full-time or part-time status, position, and division of work.
